column1: # Canonical `minimax-h3 bench` references — what scripts/bench-guard.sh diffs against.
# Measured on a COLD GPU (5 idle minutes before each point); see pitfalls/gpu-burst-vs-sustained.md.
# A hot-GPU run can be 10x slower and will fail the guard for no reason.
# This is a REGRESSION TRIPWIRE, not a cost model: the primitive sum overestimates the real step by
# 21 % at 9k tokens and underestimates it by 10-12 % at 24k-40k. Use it to detect movement, never
# to project a run — for that, see step-cost-map-2026-08.md.
# Update a row only with a fresh cold measurement, and say why in docs/knowledge/log.md.
